issues.description: Field type mismatch for Person.id: the template entity and the database schema expect a Long/BIGINT id, and the JpaRepository is parameterized with Long, but the solution's Person entity declares the backing field as Integer while its getter/setter and repository usage use Long. This inconsistency appears in solution/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java (backing field and getter/setter) and conflicts with the repository and Liquibase schema. It will cause compilation errors and incorrect JPA mapping, and will confuse students about the expected id type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.id type consistent across the entity, repository generic type, and DB schema. Change the backing field in solution/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java from Integer to Long and ensure the getId()/setId(...) signatures use Long. This aligns the entity with JpaRepository<Person, Long> and the Liquibase BIGINT column and resolves compilation/JPA mapping errors.
